name: IEA 22MW Semisubmersible
subtitle: Floating · 200 m depth · 22 MW
description: IEA 22-280-RWT reference turbine on a semisubmersible floating platform in 200 m water depth. Rotor diameter 280 m, hub height ~169 m above MSL. Full floating simulation: SeaState (JONSWAP, Hs=0.83 m, Tp=6.9 s), HydroDyn WAMIT potential flow, MoorDyn catenary mooring (3 lines, 837 m). ROSCO controller (v2.10.1).
notes: Floating semisubmersible: CompSub=0, CompMooring=3 (MoorDyn), CompHydro=1 (HydroDyn PotMod with WAMIT data). ElastoDyn platform DOFs all True (no SubDyn — ElastoDyn handles 6-DOF platform motion). WAMIT data in HydroData/ (semi.1, semi.3, semi.hst). ROSCO 2.10.1 DISCON.IN bundled.
